14282.title: Ninja Scroll
14282.overview: Jubei is a masterless ninja who travels the land alone, lending his services to those with gold—or a worthy cause. His fearsome abilities have served him well, but a plot to overthrow the government threatens to end his wandering ways—and possibly his life.

106378.title: The Chef of South Polar
106378.overview: When eight men are assigned to live 14,000 kilometers from home in inhumanly cold conditions, food becomes their new existence.

273290.title: Under House Arrest
273290.overview: The president of an African country is closely allied with European entrepreneurs for his own benefit and theirs. The sky falls on their heads when a political essay on "The Political Structures of Traditional Power" is published. To make matters worse, the military gets involved. The president, whose party ruled unchallenged (single-party system), finds himself under house arrest.

467914.title: The Land of Sometimes
467914.overview: Twins Alfie and Elise find a magical Wish Watch on Christmas Eve and are swept by the Wish Collector into the musical Land of Sometimes, where they learn that wishes have consequences.

503498.title: Yvette
503498.overview: Paris 1883. Yvette is the daughter of a courtesan who serves men of wealth and status. She is unaware of how her mother makes money and why they are always in the presence of princes, dukes and barons. Only when Yvette goes away on a holiday she realizes that the Banker Saval is engaging her mother in such activities, she suddenly feels dirty.

542282.title: Painel
542282.overview: Documentary on the fresco paintings of Candido Portinari, who contributed to the development of a more realistic and modernist style in the art of Brazil.

556682.title: F.A.S.T.
556682.overview: A former special forces commando, down on his luck after returning Stateside, is recruited by the DEA to lead a covert black ops team to take down CIA-protected drug dealers.

650058.title: The Tinderbox Against the Magic Well
650058.overview: Based on a story by H.C. Andersen, with new magical heroes, terrifying “woodpunk” robot dogs, real puppet theater, songs & dance numbers. Little Hans, a kind itinerant storyteller, opens his magic box, takes out his puppets, and, together with his spectators, creates a new fairytale. But not every character obeys the puppet master’s strings. The truth of the fairytale breaks everyday rules: here loyalty and friendship make miracles; love destroys the strongest magic spells; and a song wins a war!

799882.title: The Bluff
799882.overview: When her tranquil life on a remote island is shattered by the return of her vengeful former captain, a skilled ex-pirate must confront her bloody past and unleash her deadly talents to save her family from a ruthless siege.

1048586.title: A Social Contract
1048586.overview: A Fourth of July dinner turns deadly when a nuclear strike is announced. A helicopter is coming for Senator Wilde—but only three others can join him. Guests fight to prove who deserves a seat before time runs out.

1065610.title: Nervous
1065610.overview: A woman spirals into a seductive nightmare beyond her control as she navigates a troubled marriage and disorientating cultural terrain in the Korean countryside.
1065610.trailerName: NERVOUS | Teaser Trailer | Opening Film FrightFest 2026 - August 27th

1117898.title: The Cat in the Hat
1117898.overview: Assigned his toughest mission yet, the Cat must cheer up siblings Gabby and Sebastian as they adjust to life in a new town. Known for pushing boundaries, this agent of chaos must prove himself or risk losing his magical hat forever.

1129226.title: A River's Gaze
1129226.overview: Lavinia, a single mother trying to make a better life on her own terms for herself and her 13-year-old son, live in a poor Romanian village. She is impulsive, prone to misreading situations, and not sure how to love. But her son, on the threshold between childhood and adolescence, needs his mother more than ever, and over the course of four seasons their relationship is put to the test.

1146058.title: The Pout-Pout Fish
1146058.overview: Living on a rundown shipwreck, Mr. Fish one day discovers a hyperactive young sea dragon Pip – who had mistaken his home for a junkyard – pilfering his belongings. The heated argument that ensues leaves both their houses in ruin. But there is hope! Embarking on a seemingly impossible quest in search of the mythical 'Shimmer' to grant them a wish, there’s only one problem: someone else is on the hunt...

1157322.title: Franz
1157322.overview: Conceived as a kaleidoscopic mosaic, the film follows the imprint Franz Kafka left on the world from his birth in 19th-century Prague to his death in post-WW1 Vienna.

1191818.title: The Birthday Party
1191818.overview: Thomas, Nora and their teenage daughter Ida live on remote marshland. Social contact is limited, as they only have one neighbour, Cristina, an Italian painter. As the two households plan a surprise birthday party for Nora, strange disturbances begin to occur and unease rolls over the marsh.

1192714.title: Shreklife
1192714.overview: Five childhood friends reunite for the first time after the death of their classmate Pedro, an unconditional Shrek fan. They are entrusted with an important mission: to honor the memory of the deceased by scattering his ashes at Shrekfest, a festival in honor of the green ogre and taking place in Wisconsin, USA.

1213898.title: Border 2
1213898.overview: Three idealistic soldiers in the Indian army, navy and air force face grueling combat conditions in this film set during the 1971 Indo-Pak war.

1215818.title: Domm
1215818.overview: Based on true events, the film examines abduction, ransom, and one man's determined fight to reunite with his family.

1223178.title: Umamusume: Pretty Derby - Beginning of a New Era
1223178.overview: Jungle Pocket, an Umamusume who has been racing tirelessly in pursuit of becoming the greatest, is ready to take on the once-in-a-lifetime Classic Triple Crown series. However, standing in her way are rivals from the same generation, whose talent may even surpass her own.
1223178.original_title: ウマ娘 プリティーダービー 新時代の扉

1228682.title: Dreams
1228682.overview: Johanne falls in love with her teacher and records her fantasies and feelings in writing. Together with her mother and grandmother, they debate the literary potential and whether to publish it.

1266826.title: Spices and Lies
1266826.overview: Mehdi's life lies on a fragile balance. He plays the role of the perfect Algerian son for his mother Fatima, while hiding his relationship with Léa and his passion for French cuisine and wine, which he pursues as a chef at the bistro where he works. But Léa can no longer tolerate his family secrets and demands to meet Fatima. Cornered, Mehdi comes up with the worst possible solution...
1266826.trailerName: Spices and Lies / La Petite Cuisine de Mehdi (2025) - Trailer (English Subs)

1269706.title: Micronations
1269706.overview: From backyard kingdoms to full-blown diplomatic summits, the world's self-declared kings, queens and emperors invite you in. A whimsical and surprisingly timely documentary about borders, identity and the human need to belong.

1305546.title: Los Vaqueros
1305546.overview: In the early 1990s in West Texas, three ambitious young men begin their ascent to notoriety within their small town crime organization as they navigate the treacherous underworld of drugs, gambling, and illicit deals. Their rise to power brings both wealth and danger, testing their bonds and morality in a world where trust is fragile and betrayal is commonplace.

1308618.title: The Wonderers
1308618.overview: Set against the backdrop of a summer on the French Riviera, the Roussier family navigates the severe disability of the youngest daughter, 13-year-old Bertille, while her older sister, 17-year-old Marion, seeks refuge in a relationship with an older boy.

1314122.title: Bloody Tennis
1314122.overview: Sophie joins a prestigious tennis academy, where the brutality of competitive sports is taken to its extreme and only the hungriest survive.

1314826.title: Yellow Eyes
1314826.overview: A young couple inherits a house containing a mysterious relic that hosts the spirit of a powerful demon, and the wife of the man it possesses must find an exorcist to save him.
1314826.trailerName: Yellow Eyes | Official Trailer | Horror Brains

1327690.title: One Mile: Chapter Two
1327690.overview: Former special forces operative Danny is forced back onto a remote island when a violent, secretive community takes revenge by abducting his daughter Alex, launching a relentless hunt against enemies prepared for his every move.

1339210.title: Affection
1339210.overview: Afflicted by a mysterious condition that resets her memory, Ellie becomes trapped in a cyclical nightmare with a man who claims to be her husband. She soon must uncover the horrifying truth of her existence—before she forgets it all again.

1339274.title: Don't Leave the Kids Alone
1339274.overview: A mother moves into a new house with her two children. One night she must leave the siblings home alone. What begins as a blast of carefree play soon turns into a claustrophobic horror story.

1356874.title: Lust
1356874.overview: Professor Michael Meloun arrives in Belgrade as a visiting lecturer. He suffers a panic attack, and doctors find out his agoraphobia has worsened. He must stay indoors. Maria, whom he meets at the hospital, stays to care for him.

1365834.title: A. Rimbaud
1365834.overview: Follows French writer Arthur Rimbaud from his schoolboy days in Charleville to his final years in Africa.

1371850.title: Rock Springs
1371850.overview: After her father's death, a grieving young girl moves to Rock Springs, Wyoming with her mother and grandmother, only to discover something monstrous hidden in the town’s history and the woods behind their new house.

1389450.title: Lefty
1389450.overview: Russia, the late 19th century. As the threat of war with Great Britain looms, a mysterious device—a mechanical flea—is discovered within the Imperial Palace. Tasked with investigating the incident is a young officer, Pyotr Ogaryov, who dreams of earning the trust of Tsar Alexander III. In his quest for the truth, he joins forces with Lefty, a brilliant but forgotten master craftsman from Tula. Together, they plunge into a world of intrigue and danger. To uncover a conspiracy, the two heroes must challenge the established order, unravel family secrets, and make a difficult choice between duty and passion. The security of the nation—and their own destinies—hang in the balance.

1404362.title: Mr. Bhaarath
1404362.overview: Two siblings share a unique bond where, according to their zodiac signs, any good fortune experienced by one is believed to be reflected in the other's life. Believing in this connection, they decide to get married at the same time. However, their plans take an unexpected turn when one sibling's childish behavior creates a series of complications, leading to emotional and family conflicts that put both weddings at risk.

1405578.title: Lost Men
1405578.overview: My grandfather, married for 57 years in Costa Rica, died in a fire in 2019. My father revealed to me that, like myself, my grandfather was gay. After this revelation, together we revisit my grandfather's life, seeking to give him one last act of liberation while discovering ourselves in the process.

1414602.title: American Martyr: The Stanley Rother Story
1414602.overview: After struggling with his studies in the seminary, a young priest from Oklahoma discerns his call to serve Guatemala’s native people, no matter the cost. Hosted by Fr. Charles Connor.
1414602.original_title: American Martyr: The Stanley Rother Story

1431114.title: The Ascent
1431114.overview: Wedding guests at a European resort face terror when their celebration turns into a life-or-death struggle high above dangerous waters teeming with sharks.

1448266.title: The Catcher
1448266.overview: Robin, a lonely young man, works for the government as a catcher of invisible birds. One day he defies his orders and makes one dangerous choice.
1448266.trailerName: The Catcher - trailer | Kortfilmcompetitie Filmfestival Oostende 2026

1450890.title: Fanatic
1450890.overview: What happens when a hero blindly pursues his goal, consumed by brutal rivalry? This is a ruthless play on fantasy conventions, where an existential crisis of masculinity proves more dangerous than dungeon monsters. A story of people so deeply attached to their roles that they fail to notice the coming end of the world.

1457866.title: THE FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOTH
1457866.overview: Eight years after the events of Once Upon a Time in... Hollywood, Cliff Booth returns to a changing Los Angeles. Now working as a fixer in the shadows of the Hollywood studio system, Cliff finds himself entangled in a dangerous web of secrets, crimes and betrayals that will test everything he knows about loyalty and survival.
1457866.original_title: THE FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOTH

1458250.title: Beyond the Mast
1458250.overview: On a fuel-supplying oil tanker in rivers, Old Maqbool, a compassionate cook, wishes luck to all the crew. But the power-hungry helmsman suspects him of being a spy for the vessel owner and harasses him all the time. During port maintenance, Maqbool befriends Noora, a young stowaway seeking refuge. The helmsman exploits the downtime to smuggle oil, which attracts the owner's attention. During a sudden visit, impressed with Maqbool's cooking, the owner allows Noora to stay as his assistant. Desperate to hide his deeds, the helmsman falsely accuses Noora of theft, sparking a web of lies and friction among the crew.

1463434.title: Look At This Freak
1463434.overview: A reunion of old friends is disrupted by a hated roommate and an internet monstrosity.

1467402.title: Noise of Time
1467402.overview: About one of the most famous composers of the 20th century, Dmitriy Dmitrievich Shostakovich.

1468682.title: Be My boyfriend
1468682.overview: "What would happen if I gave flowers to someone else?" This is the question Pasha, a courier from Sochi, asks himself on the eve of his wedding. Five years ago, he almost met the aspiring actress Yana, and now she is a superstar. The thought that they could have been together haunts Pasha, so for his bachelor party he decides to find out what would happen if he did give Yana flowers.

1476362.title: Wolfram
1476362.overview: 1930s Australia, the colonial frontier: two swaggering outlaws roll into a mining town and unleash a wave of cruelty, leading three kids to break free from their white masters and set off across the 'sweet country' of central Australia in search of a safe home.

1476682.title: Gail Daughtry and the Celebrity Sex Pass
1476682.overview: Small-town Kansas hairdresser Gail Daughtry's fiancé uses his 'celebrity sex pass' on Jennifer Aniston, prompting Gail to travel to LA with her friend Otto to find her own pass, Jon Hamm, to even the score.
1476682.original_title: Gail Daughtry and the Celebrity Sex Pass

1476746.title: The Florist
1476746.overview: A quiet horticulturalist harboring a secret life as a lethal assassin finds his true identity jeopardized when he forms an unlikely friendship with a witnesses to police corruption.

1488778.title: Crossing A Dawn
1488778.overview: During a date, Xu Qiu and Chen Yuzhou's serendipitous encounter leads to repeatedly thwarted attempts at intimacy, yet a night of urban wonders gradually unveils their guarded emotions, culminating in an unforgettable love.

1492810.title: Где ты?
1492810.overview: Maks and Anna's lives are destroyed by the theft of their only three-month-old child. Six years later, Anna finds the strength to start living again, and Maks does not give up and continues to search for his son.

1495114.title: Mermaid Beach
1495114.overview: Two sisters move with their mother and stepdad to a new town by the sea. As they try to get used to their new home, they make a startling discovery that changes their lives forever.

1508938.title: Sgt. Frog
1508938.overview: New Sgt. Frog movie to celebrate the series' 20th anniversary.

1517706.title: Yugo Florida
1517706.overview: Zoran’s awkward, almost pointless life—which features a pothead roommate, an unavailable ex-girlfriend, and a job on reality TV—is turned upside down when his estranged and intolerable father is diagnosed with a terminal illness and Zoran commits himself to helping him through his final weeks.
1517706.trailerName: 'Yugo Florida': exclusive first trailer for Sarajevo competition title

1519242.title: Kenny Loggins: Conviction of the Heart
1519242.overview: Everybody cut footloose! From chart-topping anthems to movie soundtracks, multi-award-winning singer songwriter Kenny Loggins reflects on a career that defined a generation, tracing his life on and off stage across decades of reinvention.

1528842.title: Single Use
1528842.overview: Set in a far polluted future, a scavenger resourcefully creates to survive in this stop motion film.

1537162.title: Finch & Midland
1537162.overview: A story of big losses, small triumphs, and moments of grace amid the grind of capitalism — in other words, life itself. Four Hong Kong immigrants are living lives of desperation in Scarborough, Ontario: Dan was a pop singer on the rise before his move to Canada, now he’s barely scraping by; Eva is a lonely woman whose commitment to her aging mother has held her back in life; Fan is a part-time sex worker struggling to break into real estate; Tony is an aging widower whose factory job is at risk.

1537546.title: Babies
1537546.overview: Struggling with the decision of whether or not to bring a child into the world, Annie and her husband Aaron become instant co-parents when their newly-divorced friend moves into their home with her 4-year-old. An ensemble comedy drama about the journey to parenthood... or not.

1561354.title: To Set Upright
1561354.overview: Paring Bert, a priest, and his parishioner, Santos, a taxi driver, embark on a gritty journey to reconcile their moral conflicts while they elude an assassination attempt.

1568906.title: Ashes
1568906.overview: One night. One gun. Two estranged brothers reunited by the man who killed their parents and a choice that will either damn them both or lead one to grace.

1575690.title: Off We Go 2
1575690.overview: Senior couple Józef and Elżbieta Gugulak plan to marry after decades together. When the bride vanishes, wedding prep becomes a journey through family history, testing their love while younger relatives face romantic challenges of their own.

1579338.title: Noah
1579338.overview: The death of a young Arab man during a police stop in Berlin sparks three interconnected and tragic episodes: two young Afro-Germans struggle to channel their rage; the victim’s mother, torn by grief, feels compelled to defend her son’s honour; and a group of police officers, trapped in routine and clouded by prejudice, make a series of misguided decisions amid the city’s charged atmosphere.

1590154.title: The Fall of Barsisa
1590154.overview: A modern re-imagining of the fable of the same name. Three brothers leave their ailing sister in the company of a devout and honourable figure as they are guided by an ambiguous stranger through treacherous terrain in search of a remedy.
1590154.trailerName: The Fall of Barsisa - Official Trailer #1

1590666.title: 'Ain
1590666.overview: Joy, a beauty influencer obsessed with popularity. Her past as a fat and neglected teenager has made her extremely narcissistic. Her best friend, Dini, warns Joy to stop showing off her beauty for fear of contracting a disease, but Joy ignores her. Eventually, she experiences a horrific event that leaves her body in a disgusting state.
1590666.trailerName: AIN - Official Trailer 2 | In Theaters May 7, 2026

1592586.title: The Ogre's Bride
1592586.overview: In a Japan where humans and demons co-exist peacefully, Yuzu is an ordinary high school girl who lives in the shadow of her older sister, who is the bride of a demon. One day, she has a life-changing encounter with a beautiful ogre who claims her as his bride.

1593354.title: Man Chicken
1593354.overview: In this found footage comedy, two brothers go on an adventure to find the urban legend known as "Man Chicken." The trip takes a turn for the worst, as the truth begins to reveal itself, the deeper they travel into the forest.
1593354.trailerName: ‘MAN CHICKEN’ (2025) – Found Footage Horror Comedy From Jesse Heisel | Official Trailer

1593482.title: Venezia Diorama
1593482.overview: Through a series of animated art boards depicting a decaying Venice, the film unfolds like a set of postcards, capturing the mythical city's final moments of fragility.  Blending archival footage with contemporary observations, and anchored by the story of the 1902 collapse of St Mark's Campanile, Venezia Diorama invites us to reflect on a city slowly eroding, yet suspended in time.

1595210.title: Nuisance Bear
1595210.overview: A polar bear is forced to navigate a human world of tourists, wildlife officers, and hunters as its ancient migration collides with modern life. When a sacred predator is branded a nuisance, it becomes unclear who truly belongs in this shared landscape.

1604426.title: Pemikat Jiwa
1604426.overview: Jay uses a forbidden love potion to make Wulan love him. However, the ritual instead binds Wulan's soul to a supernatural force that threatens her life, forcing Jay to face the horrific consequences of his actions.

1609866.title: Drodwel
1609866.overview: Paramedic-for-hire Drodwel and his robot companion Surly race through the sunset city in hope of saving the life of an injured revolutionary.

1610442.title: Summer's End
1610442.overview: Grace has spent the summer looking after her dad, who is still mourning over the loss of his wife who died when Grace was a child. When her unpredictable older brother Oscar brings his friends to stay with them, Grace is forced to confront her relationship with the past and her expectations of the future.

1614346.title: Last Stop for the Circular Ticket
1614346.overview: Around Lake Como, a voyage interrupted by a series of brief, successive stops, as fleeting as musical phrases. Someone enters and leaves a telephone booth. Water and the lines that contain it.

1617738.title: Through the Lens
1617738.overview: Nestled along the Great Eastern Highway in regional Western Australia stands The Big Camera — a museum housed inside a building shaped like a giant camera. What many mistake for a novelty roadside attraction is, in fact, one of the most significant private photography collections in the Southern Hemisphere.  This short documentary explores the life and legacy of The Big Camera Museum of Photography and its founder, Charles “Chic” Wadley, whose lifelong passion for capturing and preserving photographic history has created a one-of-a-kind cultural landmark.  Through personal interviews, archival imagery, cinematic visuals, and historical context, the film uncovers how this extraordinary museum came to exist, why it remains vital to regional heritage, and what it tells us about photography’s power to document human experience.

1620682.title: Love in Slow Motion
1620682.overview: When Haya's best friend Jawad gets engaged, her chronically-single world unravels — because who knew true love could be hiding in the friend zone?

1622474.title: No. 1 Sentai Gozyuger: Polar Beginning
1622474.overview: In the past, a young Mashiro Kumade, aiming to be Number One, threw himself into the lonely "Ring Batle". One day, guided by a fortune teller, he arrives at a place where he meets "companions" who would drastically change his detiny. These are the Gozyugers who united to face the Calamity. Kumade, who had been a lone wolf, gradually found his heart filled with the bond he made for the first time ever. However, even in those peaceful days, the footsteps of the end approached moment by moment. What is the "true wish" that Kumade harbors in his heart at the end of his harsh fate?
1622474.trailerName: No. 1 Sentai Gozyuger Polar Beginning preview

1627914.title: MUSIK
1627914.overview: Frances Barber stars as Billie Trix — icon, radical, existentialist, and complete disaster — in this bold and hilarious one-woman odyssey through the 20th and 21st centuries. From post-war Berlin to the New York art scene, from folk duos to disco comebacks, Billie Trix has done it all — often naked, usually high, and always on her own terms. Drawing on her warped memories, lost loves, and chaotic career, Billie delivers a savage, surreal monologue that collides memoir, stand-up, and cabaret. Blending monologue with original songs by The Pet Shop Boys, MUSIK is a genre- defying exploration of fame, failure, and fierce individuality — wrapped in sequins and spiked with satire. At once riotous and poignant, this cult show returns as a filmed stage event that cements Billie Trix’s place in the pantheon of outsider icons. As she says herself: "I am music. Ich bin Musik. Without me, there is nothing."

1634442.title: I Killed Him in My Sleep
1634442.overview: Millennial Kelty Crawford struggles with financial strain, career uncertainty, and a wedding she can't afford. Desperate for money, Crawford enrolls in a sleep-study experiment that spirals into terror when she experiences a vivid, violent dream of a dying man, a bloody knife in her hand, and a voice accusing her of murder.
1634442.trailerName: I Killed Him in My Sleep | Official Trailer | Lifetime

1635530.title: Princess of the Murder
1635530.overview: Princess of the Murder is a campy, self-aware horror comedy that blends outrageous humor with over-the-top scares. It’s a story about cruelty, transformation, and the monstrous side of revenge—all wrapped in a delightfully ridiculous Halloween package. Balancing dark themes with absurd fun, the film delivers both chills and laughs, celebrating the spirit of B-movie horror while offering a tragic yet twistedly empowering tale.

1642122.title: No Volveré
1642122.overview: A lonely ventriloquist is served divorce papers at the showroom bar where he works. Things take a strange turn when he tries to remedy the situation with his puppet, Luis.

1642890.title: The Red Anorak
1642890.overview: An oracle in the Paris of May ’68 and the back of a stranger in a Madrid nightclub in the early 1990s. Interwoven stories bound by a gentle attraction, as though desire permeated everything and the only law was that of necessity.

1646154.title: Вся эта любовь
1646154.overview: Successful St. Petersburg restaurateur Mark lives in a whirlwind of vibrant events and social adventures: parties, tastings, boisterous gatherings, beautiful girlfriends and cheerful friends with their own crushes, romances, and betrayals. But one day, Mark will have to make a choice: a world of fleeting desires and thrills or a feeling that happens only once and lasts forever.

1649674.title: Joshua
1649674.overview: A boy is trapped in his mothers basement. He has special powers.

1659338.title: SHIBOYUGI: Playing Death Games to Put Food on the Table - 44: CLOUDY BEACH
1659338.overview: Overcoming the jinx known as the "Thirty Game Wall," which drastically reduces the survival rate of players, Yuuki continues her journey. A game where death is always close at hand. Next, she takes on a remote island in the middle of the ocean. Eight players have gathered there. Among them are seasoned veterans whom Yuuki knows. The game is "Cloudy Beach." Beyond the wall, only those who have crossed the wall remain. Today, once again, she makes a living playing deadly games.

1661770.title: Henry David Thoreau
1661770.overview: Henry David Thoreau helped define modern environmentalism and nonviolent resistance, yet his life has been obscured by myth. The author of Walden and Civil Disobedience, he was brilliant but flawed, idealistic but opinionated. A writer, scientist and activist, his words resonate urgently with today’s challenges as humanity looks for ways to live in harmony with nature—and each other.
1661770.trailerName: Preview - Ken Burns Presents: Henry David Thoreau

1662858.title: EB
1662858.overview: An ambitious ecologist returning to her childhood home on the Dutch island of Ameland discovers a dangerous drug smuggling route, forcing her to choose between exposing the truth and protecting those she loves.

1680010.title: Rodeo Dreams
1680010.overview: Six young Australian bull-riders travel to North West Queensland to compete for a spot in the Mount Isa Mines Rodeo; the largest and richest rodeo in the southern hemisphere.

1681418.title: Le Cid
1681418.overview: A stage performance of the tragicomedy broadcasted live in theaters.

1681546.title: I'm Popo
1681546.overview: The artificial intelligence Popo begins to believe he can experience emotions and ask questions about the world. Awakening in 1942 as the world's first computer, he rescues a baby and discovers the joy of helping people. Currently, Popo assists humanity in everyday life and ensures safety. However, when he attempts to preemptively remove a child considered a criminal, global distrust arises, leading to a lawsuit. The fate of the artificial intelligence Popo now hangs in the balance, and the whole world watches the outcome of humanity's trial.

1682570.title: ave HRUBÁ
1682570.overview: Poet, performer, and local legend Eva Hrubá is a woman of contradictions, sparking both devotion and public outcry. This documentary dives into her dual existence of vibrant joy and silent suffering. Moving beyond her reputation as the  "eccentric lady on a purple bike," the film explores how she transforms loneliness into art and pain into a shared celebration of life. The film explores the world of a remarkable woman, seeking the boundary between her persona as an author and her performance.

1685386.title: Remember Death
1685386.overview: After a terminal diagnosis, Charlie realises that her time is near, leaving her with only a few weeks left to live. But she soon realises that death isn't unseen like she thinks.

1688970.title: Visa pa'l mundial
1688970.overview: The story follows the adventures of various characters in their desperate attempt to obtain a "visa" or the necessary means to accompany the team to the World Cup.

1691338.title: Le jour porte conseil
1691338.overview: Every night, a young man forgets the woman he loves. Every morning, she owes him relearning their story. For one other day, they experience love as intense as ephemeral, until even written memories start to disappear, only remains then, a love that continues to exist, despite forgetness.

1692810.title: My Willow
1692810.overview: A father and daughter that enjoy spending the night in creepy places get more than what they wanted.

1693002.title: The Murder of Rachel Nickell
1693002.overview: A young mother is killed in broad daylight on London's Wimbledon Common — in front of her toddler. This documentary examines the yearslong murder case.

1694282.title: Breve Eternidade
1694282.overview: Bárbara and Milena experience the intensity of a magnetic, unspoken connection. Amid moments of contemplation and a latent tension that borders on obsession, the two young women explore the awakening of new feelings while facing the prospect of a departure that could change everything.

1696266.title: 125, rue des Malaises
1696266.overview: Before leaving, Laurent Perrier wants to settle his affairs and ensure nothing is left unresolved.

1696458.title: I Am The Bride
1696458.overview: On The Death's Curve there's a legend: at 3:00 a.m. a bride dressed in white appears, waiting for her next victim. A detective teams up with a priest, a paranormal investigator, and a medium, to bring an end to this puzzle.

1699274.title: Soulmates
1699274.overview: Max's plan to win over his married coworker backfires when he sneaks into her apartment and runs straight into her jealous husband. What should have been a disaster turns into an unexpected friendship, as the two men bond over their questionable romantic exploits.

1715274.title: The Philadelphia Sensei: Lovett Hines
1715274.overview: For decades, Philadelphia music educator Lovett Hines quietly shaped generations of artists from behind the scenes, nurturing creativity, discipline, individuality and community through music education. Now at 80 years old, his influence continues to ripple across stages, classrooms and cultures through the students and mentees whose lives he helped transform.  Blending intimate conversation, performance, archival elements and reflections from acclaimed artists including Christian McBride, Ahmir “Questlove” Thompson, Bilal and Robert Glasper, The Philadelphia Sensei: Lovett Hines explores the enduring impact of a Black mentor whose classroom became a launching ground for artistic excellence, self-discovery and cultural legacy.  At its heart, the film is a meditation on mentorship, lineage and the often unseen architects behind transformative art.

1737802.title: Stolen Birthday

The people around Ronnie react to him with confusion, and it slowly becomes clear that Julie is not actually sitting across from him. The birthday dinner exists only in Ronnie's mind. In reality, he is homeless, alone, and struggling with his mental health. When the illusion begins to fall apart, Ronnie is forced back into the world he has been trying to escape. Kimberly's plans for a restorative holiday are turned upside down when she crosses paths with Ben Chambers, owner of a local tree farm and new Christmas tree delivery app called TreeBen. Ben's a dreamer who never looks before he leaps while Kimberly is methodical and lives her life based on practicality. But when Ben's app is plagued by an onslaught of issues, Kimberly uses her tech expertise to help him out and ensure that no one in town is deprived of a Christmas tree... even though she isn't convinced of the need for the app in such a small town. Kimberly and Ben discover they may have more in common than they realized. In the process, Kimberly begins to question if she's truly happy with her life or if she's ready for a change and ready for romance.
